description: Figure 4.1 (first subplot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny”) illustrates how word error rate (WER) changes over fine-tuning epochs for the Whisper “tiny” model under four training configurations shown as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 20 up to 70 with evenly spaced tick marks (about 10-unit steps). Four gray lines are plotted with small circular markers: a solid line for “tiny AdaLoRA_init4,” a dashed line for “tiny AdaLoRA_init8,” a dotted line for “tiny init4,” and a dash-dot line for “tiny full.” The “tiny AdaLoRA_init4” line starts near 70 at epoch 0 and declines across epochs to the mid-to-high 30s by epoch 6, with a noticeable drop between epochs 2 and 4. The “tiny AdaLoRA_init8” line begins around 60 at epoch 0 and decreases to the mid-30s by epoch 6, with a steady downward trend and smaller changes after about epoch 4. The “tiny init4” line starts near the high 20s at epoch 0 and gradually decreases to the low-to-mid 20s by epoch 6, remaining well below the other lines throughout. The “tiny full” line begins around the high 60s at epoch 0 and declines to the low-to-mid 30s by epoch 6, with a sharper decrease through about epoch 4 and then a flatter trajectory toward the end.
